category_title: Adolescents with Major Depressive Disorder experiencing psychomotor retardation, cognitive disorganization, and emotional volatility
minimal_context: The student and tutor are sitting together to organize the student's binder and backpack before starting their schoolwork.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start by organizing your binder and backpack so we can begin your schoolwork.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shuffles papers from side to side) My backpack is a mess. It's just bits of paper in whirlwind in here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look through it and decide what you need to keep and what you can throw away.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know what to throw away. I can't make decisions about my work right now, I can't organize this material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let's just find some binder paper so we can start writing the first assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the inch of paper in the open binder right in front of him and stands up) I'm going to my room to get some. The family cat is being fairly annoying anyway.
